messages.subject: Should I conduct "assocComp+removeComp" work iteratively?
parts:
Dear all, 

I work on some gender-mixed methylation data. 
To remove effect from gender, I conducted "assocComp+removeComp" work. 
But, I found significant PCs are still exists when I conducted assocComp againt to "assocComp+removeComp" conducted data. 

So, I wonder whether should I conduct "assocComp+removeComp" work iteratively (until no significant PCs exist), or just one shot.

Regards,
Youngjune

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] Should I conduct "assocComp+removeComp" work iteratively?
parts:
Ok, I will do it once to be on the safe side, every time you remove a component you are likely removing real biological variation, you don’t want to that too much. 

you can also try sth like SVA for better unwanted batch effect removal but I can’t advise you on how to use that for methylation values, maybe it works out of the box, I just don’t know.
